newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BIUROSYSTEM PLANS BOURSE ENTRY.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BIUROSYSTEM PLANS BOURSE ENTRY.

text.p: Polish office equipment distributor Biurosystem SA plans to issue 434,000 new shares and enter the Warsaw bourse's parallel market, the firm's president said on Thursday.
Stanislaw Kosucki told Reuters the company had already sent its issue prospectus to the Polish Securities Commission.

"We are planning to issue 434,000 shares at a par value of five zlotys...and our share capital will grow...to over three million zlotys, which will let us in a longer perspective to enter the Warsaw bourse's parallel market," he said.
Biurosystem, which employs 200, had sales of 21.5 million zlotys in 1996.
